title: Make range track color contract honest
description: Apply the third range implementation slice by correcting the misleading selected-track control contract without introducing a custom dual-range engine.
objective: Ensure the Elementor style controls describe what the current native range implementation can actually render, while isolating rating color from range color.
expected_outputs: Honest Elementor label and description for the range accent control
Range accent CSS variable with backward-compatible fill variable
Rating color isolated from range track color
Documentation explaining why true selected interval fill remains deferred
acceptance_criteria: The style panel no longer promises a true selected interval track.
Existing saved range color settings continue to affect the native range accent.
Range track color does not mutate rating text when both range and rating filters exist.
No custom slider engine or selected interval overlay is introduced in this slice.
Guilherme remains responsible for final visual judgment if the editor copy still feels awkward.
verification: PHP lint passes for changed PHP files.
JS syntax check passes if frontend assets are included in validation.
git diff --check passes in root and plugin.
Static checks confirm Selected Track copy is removed and Range Accent copy exists.

budgets.context_budget: range audit, range style controls, range CSS variables
budgets.research_budget: local source and prior audit docs
budgets.validation_budget: lint, composer, syntax, static contract checks

risks: This intentionally does not create a true visual interval fill.
Users may still expect more track styling controls until Slice D expands range craft.
